basic_info.description: This top-floor one-bedroom home at 35 Dolores Street combines modern city living with boutique luxury amenities in San Francisco's tech epicenter. Located steps from Dolores Park, Whole Foods, and the vibrant scenes of the Mission, Castro, and Hayes Valley, this quiet Residence #409 offers the perfect work-from-home sanctuary with gigabit fiber-ready infrastructure and open-concept layout featuring floor-to-ceiling windows for natural light during those long coding sessions. The sleek kitchen with quartz countertops and premium stainless steel appliances flows seamlessly into the living area, ideal for hosting team meetings or demo days. A private deeded patio provides the perfect outdoor workspace or networking venue. Additional tech-friendly features include a spacious contemporary bathroom, stacking washer-dryer, generous storage for equipment, and secure bicycle parking for your commute to SOMA or South Bay. With prime positioning across from Whole Foods and easy access to the city's startup ecosystem, this home offers the ideal base for scaling your next venture in one of the world's most innovative neighborhoods.
